acceptance_criteria.criterion: The root package.json declares npm workspaces for all 16 mandated directories, and each directory exists with valid workspace metadata.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: package.json enumerates exactly the 16 required paths; each has a package.json with a unique @ciclo package name, version, and private workspace metadata. Configuration test 20 passed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A committed package-lock.json is present, and npm ci succeeds from a clean checkout in the authoritative validation environment.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Candidate contains lockfileVersion 3 package-lock.json. Authoritative dependency-install ran `npm ci --no-audit --no-fund` and exited 0, adding 132 packages.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No pnpm-workspace.yaml, pnpm-lock.yaml, pnpm shim, pnpm packageManager declaration, or pnpm invocation exists in repository-controlled configuration, scripts, source, or CI.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Root package metadata has no packageManager entry or pnpm dependency/invocation; CI uses npm exclusively. Workspace tests 23 and 24 passed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The exact root commands npm run compile, npm run lint, npm run boundary, and npm run test each exit 0 after npm ci.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Implementer validation records PASS for all four exact commands. Authoritative validation independently confirmed npm installation, lint, and test; all 44 tests passed, including the committed-state boundary sweep. Compile is a direct `tsc -b tsconfig.json` gate over all project references.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Every TypeScript workspace configuration extends the shared base configuration, and the effective configuration enables strict and noUncheckedIndexedAccess.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: All 15 TypeScript workspace tsconfig files extend tsconfig.base.json, which sets strict and noUncheckedIndexedAccess true. Configuration tests 16 and 17 passed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: TypeScript source discovery and relevant gates cover .ts, .tsx, .mts, and .cts files.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Every workspace include list and boundary SOURCE_EXTENSIONS cover all four extensions; ESLint builds its glob from the same four-extension list. Configuration test 18 passed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The pure-package lint restrictions apply to all four TypeScript extensions under packages/; any exception is confined to packages/adapters or packages/ui as allowed by the specification.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: PURE_PACKAGE_EXTENSIONS contains ts, tsx, mts, and cts; only adapters and ui receive impure overrides. Negative .mts/.cts fixtures and positive exception tests passed in tests 27–44.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The boundary checker rejects forbidden direct cross-workspace imports, including relative cross-workspace imports, while permitting only direct edges declared by §14.5 and not treating transitive reachability as permission.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: graph.mjs contains the explicit directed edge map and no implicit self-edge. lib.mjs permits only identical package identity or an explicit direct graph edge. Tests reject forbidden package, transitive-only, relative, same-node app, and same-node tool imports; positive direct-edge and same-workspace cases pass.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: CI uses npm ci and runs compile, lint, boundary, and test successfully against committed state.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml checks out the repository, configures Node 20 with npm caching, runs npm ci, then invokes all four exact root gates. Configuration test 25 passed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: SPEC_BLOCKERS.md exists with the fields required by §19 and does not record a fabricated resolution.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: SPEC_BLOCKERS.md defines identifier, status, conflicting sections, impact, affected work fronts, origin, provisional decision, and resolution fields. All registries are explicitly empty and no resolution is claimed; test 26 passed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No production algorithm, economic behavior, or behavior dependent on an unresolved DEFINIR item is introduced.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Workspace source files contain only `export {}` placeholders. Changes are limited to bootstrap configuration, validation tooling, tests, CI, and registry documentation.

invariants_checked: All 16 mandated npm workspaces are registered.
All 15 TypeScript projects inherit strict and noUncheckedIndexedAccess.
All relevant source gates cover .ts, .tsx, .mts, and .cts.
§14.5 permissions use direct edges rather than transitive reachability.
Same architecture-node membership does not grant cross-workspace access.
Relative cross-workspace imports are subject to boundary validation.
Pure-package restrictions apply outside only the authorized adapters and ui exceptions.
No production domain, economic, replay, persistence, RNG, encoding, or hashing behavior was introduced.
No unresolved DEFINIR item or contradiction was silently resolved.
No ledger or arithmetic behavior is present, so ledger and rounding invariants are unaffected.
No temporary or debug artifact was identified in candidate scope.
payload.summary: Candidate satisfies the npm-only FASE-1 bootstrap requirements. The iteration-2 boundary fix correctly rejects undeclared same-node cross-workspace imports while preserving same-workspace imports and explicit §14.5 direct edges. Automated clean installation, lint, and all 44 tests passed; the implementer also reports successful exact compile and boundary gates.
